title: Singular Stochastic Heat Equations with Fractional Memory
summary: We extend the paracontrolled distribution approach of Gubinelli, Imkeller, and Perkowski to singular stochastic heat equations with Caputo fractional time derivatives. By establishing Schauder estimates for the time-fractional heat flow and controlling history terms, we address the difficulties arising from temporal memory and the lack of the semigroup property. For the one-dimensional rough Burgers-type equation driven by space-time white noise with spatial dissipation \((-Δ)^σ\), we prove global well-posedness for \(σ\in(5/6,1]\) and \(ν\in(6σ/(12σ-5),1]\).
